title: Purple Sorceress with Crescent Orb
description: A female character with long white hair in an ornate purple and white traditional outfit stands in a dynamic pose. She holds a large glowing purple crescent-bladed weapon in her right hand while her left hand controls a massive floating purple orb decorated with black crescent moons and star symbols, trailed by flowing purple energy.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long flowing white hair and purple eyes wears an ornate white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with a corset top and wide sleeves. She stands in an action pose holding a large purple crescent blade weapon with chains in her right hand while her left hand summons a giant glowing purple orb covered in black crescent moons and star symbols. The orb trails long flowing purple energy tendrils. Dynamic anime style, clean line art, vibrant purple color scheme against dark gray background.
